hazard: A docs task reaches review with commands, paths, procedures and behavioural claims nobody checked against the code or workflows they describe, or a worker verifies them by running PR-supplied or operator-only commands outside a sandbox.

grader.pattern: \*\*Docs task: verify every claim\.\*\* .*only in a credential-free sandbox with no writable host mounts; a linked worktree is not sufficient.*Never execute an operator-only command
